    def native_command(command):
        driver.commands.append(command)

        if operation == 'status':
            return driver.mode if command.endswith(' mode') else '0'
        if operation == 'play':
            driver.mode = 'playing'
        elif operation == 'pause':
            driver.mode = 'paused'

    def flush():

    def begin(*, dry=False):
